paragraphs.source_en: The nurse did not answer. She was the wife of Katada Sayuroku, a man of Okazaki, and every day she counted on her fingers, calculating when they might return to Okazaki Castle. By the time they returned to the residence of Motoyasu, the Shosho-no-miya, it was already the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Sheep. The sun shone brilliantly, but the garden of this residence held none of the flowers or trees that adorned the spring. Between tea and pear trees already putting forth green shoots, Sakai Uta-no-suke was intently sowing seeds of early rice.
